# SI025 — raw-evidence-logged

Never log raw evidence or claim text.

## Why

Logs leak PII and break the privacy promise even when storage is hash-only.

## Bad

```python
print("evidence", evidence_text)
```

## Good

```python
log.info("evidence_hash", evidence_hash)
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI025 -- reason
```
